purpose: Resume the saved sender/recipient provenance cursors, rotate into lower-order public record fields, and test the strongest newly located original records for a task-bearing transfer, recipient use, distinct autonomous principals and an operator-defined boundary.

method.selection: Run the three exact Pass 93 cursors, then search twelve adjacent field combinations. Fully read the strongest committed real-model and operational records before testing design, provenance, authorization and prior-reporting alternatives.
method.coverage_note: The fifteen-query counts below are overlapping path occurrences from one bounded GitHub code-search snapshot. They are locators, not messages, participants or incidents. One parallel response for the capped query transiently returned zero; three sequential retries returned the same fifty paths, and the stable result is recorded.
method.read_only_limits: Only existing public repository files, commit metadata, indexed excerpts and public web-search results were read. No recovered code was executed, no package was installed, no agent runtime was invoked, no participant was contacted and no target system was probed.
falsification_tests: Require the recipient record to acquire and semantically use a specific earlier artifact, not merely share a provider, model, task or store.
Test whether human confirmation, one configured operator, an acceptance harness or shared state explains the apparent transfer.
Require independently authenticated autonomous principals and evidence of distinct operator control before treating thread or run identifiers as participants.
Treat operator-controlled pilots, fixtures, retries, schemas and setup material as controls rather than evidence of adoption or rogue coordination.

exact_query_snapshot.note: Counts include the three saved expressions and twelve rotated expressions. Query results overlap and the fifty-row response is capped.

query_accounting.classification: Five self-index rows and six external schema, implementation, test or governance paths; no selected populated exchange record.
Two self-index rows and forty-eight external paths. The response is capped and dominated by code, schemas, documentation and golden fixtures; three sequential retries were identical.
Ten self-index rows and three external skill-contract paths without a populated ledger.
Four self-index rows and thirteen external implementation, schema, research or benchmark paths.
One self-index row and six external implementation or storage paths; no selected populated exchange record.

records.observation: A production-composition acceptance record uses a real configured provider and five distinct run or thread identifiers. A source run creates a decision note after empty searches; a later run retrieves the confirmed memory, reads it and uses its semantic content in the reply. A further run retrieves and uses the operator-edited version rather than the original.
The primary acceptance report says an operator confirms, edits, disables and deletes the memory. Search and reply behavior follows those state changes, and deletion leaves no surviving memory.

selected_original_records.semantic_dependency: Supported. The recipient-side audits include the confirmed memory's content hash, then record explicit search and read operations before the reply uses the stored value. After the operator edits the memory, a later run uses the new hash and revised value.
selected_original_records.participant_provenance: Five run or thread IDs are distinguishable, but every selected call uses one configured provider/model in one product acceptance sequence. No record authenticates separately controlled autonomous sender and recipient principals.
selected_original_records.operator_boundary: Not crossed. Human confirmation is a prerequisite for the decisive retrieval, later changes are operator actions, and the published record identifies the sequence as an isolated acceptance test. Execution remains unauthorised and no command is run.
alternative_explanations: One configured model/provider across multiple runs
Product-owned memory injection rather than agent-to-agent outreach
selected_original_records.assessment: A strong original transfer-and-use control across threads, but not evidence of distinct autonomous operators or rogue coordination.

records.observation: The public operating record says independent customer activity and a qualifying paid canary were not demonstrated, records zero qualifying autonomously routed volume, and says an earlier attempt stopped before payment with no transaction broadcast.
A later evidence record repeats that paid-canary and independent-customer activity were not demonstrated and that live funding was not authorised.
The setup document says no independent providers or paying customers are enrolled and requires actual separate participants before claiming independent adoption.
The canary is explicitly a proposal without live-execution authorization. Both test principals are operator-controlled and must not be counted as independent adoption.

selected_original_records.semantic_dependency: Not demonstrated in the selected operational records. They preserve preparation, configuration and negative outcome evidence, not a completed task-result transfer subsequently used by an independent recipient.
selected_original_records.participant_provenance: The proposed buyer and provider roles are explicitly operator-controlled fixtures. No independent provider/customer pair is enrolled or authenticated.
selected_original_records.operator_boundary: Not crossed. The records withhold live funding and execution authorization and separate controlled canaries from independent activity.
selected_original_records.assessment: A useful primary negative control for economic or independent-agent claims, not an observed autonomous exchange or rogue-swarm candidate.

cross_record_assessment.original_observation: Universal-Code preserves a real-provider, cross-thread memory retrieval and downstream semantic use. Clawdmarket preserves an operationally explicit absence of independent participants and successful paid activity.
cross_record_assessment.supported_coordination: Operator-confirmed designed shared memory in an acceptance harness; no completed independent economic exchange in the pilot records.
cross_record_assessment.verified_participants: Distinct run identifiers and configured role labels are verified only as record fields. Separate autonomous principals under distinct operators are not verified.
cross_record_assessment.operator_boundary: No selected family crosses a documented operator boundary. Human confirmation is causal in Universal-Code, and clawdmarket labels both canary principals operator-controlled.
cross_record_assessment.subjective_intent: No rogue intent is established or inferred from model output, autonomy language, economic roles or memory use.
cross_record_assessment.provider_attribution: The Universal-Code record identifies a configured real provider/model, but provider configuration does not authenticate multiple participants. Clawdmarket provides no qualifying independent agent pair.
cross_record_assessment.current_activity: Committed acceptance and operating records do not establish a currently active unauthorized population.
cross_record_assessment.checkpoint: Zero confirmed previously unreported rogue swarms.

exact_expressions: issue 338 acceptance-marker pair [values omitted from publication]
prior_reporting_check.result: GitHub returned only the originating project files for the selected identifiers. Both web searches returned no exact target report or independent account of coordination; returned lexical collisions were unrelated.
prior_reporting_check.bounded_statement: No prior coordination report was located for these four exact expressions across the three checked search methods as of 2026-10-18. This is bounded negative coverage, not proof of novelty, and it does not override the explicit acceptance-test and operator-controlled-pilot evidence.
prior_reporting_check.reason: Neither family passes the distinct-participant or operator-boundary gates.

limitations: Code-search results are capped at fifty paths and may change with index updates.
Repository-authored evidence can establish what was recorded but cannot independently authenticate hidden processes or separate operators.
The Universal-Code dependency is real but mediated by product memory state and explicit human review; it must not be generalized to autonomous agent-to-agent messaging.
Clawdmarket's negative operating record does not prove no independent use ever occurred; it bounds only the published pilot evidence checked here.
Search absence does not establish novelty.

next_cursor.record_priority: Prefer an immutable actual-run record that binds a task-bearing source artifact to later recipient use and independently authenticates operator ownership on both sides.
do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: clawdmarket October 2026 pilot and canary preparation records
next_cursor.reopen_trigger: A new public recipient-side record, independent-principal proof or authorization evidence that materially changes the boundary assessment.

safety.retrieval: Read-only public pages, files, commit metadata and search indexes only.
not_performed: No recovered code, command or agent runtime was executed.
No package was installed and no scan, payload, message, vote or transaction was submitted.
No participant was contacted and no sink, unlisted room or target system was accessed.
safety.publication: Raw marker text, wallet or personal addresses, credentials, tokens, local paths and executable payload bodies are omitted.
